# OSINT / LAB (working name)

> Free, source-available OSINT (open-source intelligence) toolkit that runs in the browser. An independently redesigned derivative of Kerlooo/FreeOSINTUI, inspired by OSINT-UI. No account or paywall; some threat feeds require an optional operator API key. Available in English, Italian, French and Japanese.

Most tools run entirely client-side: inputs and files stay in the user's browser. A few (Username Analyzer, Telegram OSINT, parts of Reputation Checker, URL Analyzer and Passive Site Footprint) use a small backend for sources that block browser requests. Lookup tools accept a prefilled value with `?q=<value>` (Google Dork Generator: `/dorks?type=<username|email|name|phone|domain>&q=<value>`; Leak Check: `/leaks?email=<email>`).

## Search

- [Dork builder](http://localhost:8787/dorks): Build targeted Google searches for accounts, emails, names, phone numbers and domains.

## People & accounts

- [Email inspection](http://localhost:8787/email): Check address syntax, provider type, mail servers, email security and public Gravatar details.
- [Username radar](http://localhost:8787/username): Check a username across hundreds of public sites using the WhatsMyName catalogue.
- [Phone inspection](http://localhost:8787/phone): Validate number formats, country and number type locally. Get links for further research.
- [Telegram profiles](http://localhost:8787/telegram): Read public account previews, member counts and recent posts from public channels.
- [GitHub footprint](http://localhost:8787/github): Explore public profiles, repositories, organizations, commit emails and published keys.

## Domains & network

- [Domain recon](http://localhost:8787/domain): Inspect DNS, email security, registration data, certificate subdomains and archived pages.
- [IP recon](http://localhost:8787/ip): Explore network ownership, approximate location, reverse DNS and passive port and CVE data.
- [Lookalike domains](http://localhost:8787/lookalike): Generate domain lookalikes and check DNS and mail records for possible phishing leads.
- [Favicon fingerprint](http://localhost:8787/favicon): Calculate favicon hashes locally and open searches for infrastructure using the same icon.
- [Archive footprint](http://localhost:8787/footprint): Explore archived URLs in Common Crawl and Wayback without contacting the target site.

## Threat intel & phishing

- [Email header inspection](http://localhost:8787/headers): Reconstruct mail routes and inspect authentication results and suspicious header mismatches.
- [URL inspection](http://localhost:8787/url): Inspect link structure and suspicious patterns. Expand short links and consult public threat sources.
- [Reputation signals](http://localhost:8787/reputation): Compare IPs, domains, URLs and emails with public threat feeds. Listings are leads, not proof.

## Breaches

- [Breach check](http://localhost:8787/leaks): Look for known email breaches and exposed passwords using password hash prefixes.

## Files & hashes

- [Hash lab](http://localhost:8787/hash): Calculate file and text hashes, identify possible hash types and compare fingerprints.
- [Metadata explorer](http://localhost:8787/metadata): Extract image, PDF and Office metadata locally: authors, dates, software and available GPS data.

## Blockchain

- [Crypto trail](http://localhost:8787/crypto): Inspect supported crypto addresses, balances and recent transactions. Follow counterparties.

## Decoders & utilities

- [ID & time decoder](http://localhost:8787/timestamp): Decode supported platform IDs and timestamps, or convert dates between formats.
- [MAC vendor lookup](http://localhost:8787/mac): Identify IEEE vendor assignments, convert address formats and spot local or multicast addresses.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/Kerlooo/FreeOSINTUI): SvelteKit frontend and FastAPI backend.
